Portrait - neutral, facing camera.label: Portrait - neutral, facing camera
Portrait - neutral, facing camera.brief: {A} faces the camera straight on, head level, eyes open and looking into the lens, mouth relaxed, shoulders square to the frame, hands out of frame.

Portrait - soft smile.label: Portrait - soft smile
Portrait - soft smile.brief: {A} faces the camera with the head tilted a few degrees, a soft closed-mouth smile, eyes to the lens, one hand resting at the side of the neck.

Portrait - looking away.label: Portrait - looking away
Portrait - looking away.brief: {A} stands with the body at three-quarters to the camera, head turned away to the side, eyes on something outside the frame, hands relaxed at the sides.

Portrait - over the shoulder.label: Portrait - over the shoulder
Portrait - over the shoulder.brief: {A} stands with the back three-quarters to the camera and looks back over one shoulder into the lens, chin near the shoulder, one hand loose at the hip.

Portrait - from above, looking up.label: Portrait - from above, looking up
Portrait - from above, looking up.brief: {A} sits or crouches low and tilts the face up to the camera, eyes to the lens, shoulders relaxed, hands on the knees.

Portrait - profile.label: Portrait - profile
Portrait - profile.brief: {A} stands side-on in full profile, face forward, eyes looking ahead out of frame, gaze directed past the camera, arms relaxed.

Portrait - chin on hand.label: Portrait - chin on hand
Portrait - chin on hand.brief: {A} leans forward with one elbow on a surface, chin resting on the back of the hand, eyes to the lens, the other arm folded under it.

Portrait - hands in hair.label: Portrait - hands in hair
Portrait - hands in hair.brief: {A} faces the camera with both hands in the hair, elbows out, head tilted back slightly, eyes half closed and lips parted.

Portrait - laughing.label: Portrait - laughing
Portrait - laughing.brief: {A} faces the camera mid-laugh, head tipped back, eyes squeezed shut, one hand lifted near the chest, shoulders loose.

Portrait - serious, low angle.label: Portrait - serious, low angle
Portrait - serious, low angle.brief: {A} stands tall with the chin slightly down, eyes straight into a low camera, arms at the sides, expression flat and direct.

Solo - standing, relaxed.label: Solo - standing, relaxed
Solo - standing, relaxed.brief: {A} stands facing the camera with the weight on one leg, the other knee soft, hips slightly offset, arms hanging loose, face to the lens.

Solo - standing, hand on hip.label: Solo - standing, hand on hip
Solo - standing, hand on hip.brief: {A} stands three-quarters to the camera, weight on the back leg, one hand planted on the hip with the elbow out, the other arm relaxed, chin lifted.

Solo - sitting on a chair.label: Solo - sitting on a chair
Solo - sitting on a chair.brief: {A} sits on a chair facing the camera, both feet on the floor, knees together, hands resting on the thighs, back away from the backrest.

Solo - sitting on the floor.label: Solo - sitting on the floor
Solo - sitting on the floor.brief: {A} sits on the floor with the knees drawn up and both arms wrapped around them, chin on the knees, eyes to the camera.

Solo - kneeling.label: Solo - kneeling
Solo - kneeling.brief: {A} kneels upright on both knees facing the camera, thighs together, hands resting on the thighs, back straight, face to the lens.

Solo - crouching.label: Solo - crouching
Solo - crouching.brief: {A} crouches low on the balls of the feet, knees apart, forearms resting on the knees, face lifted to the camera.

Solo - lying on the back.label: Solo - lying on the back
Solo - lying on the back.brief: {A} lies on the back along a surface, one knee bent, arms above the head, face turned to the camera, body in a long line.

Solo - lying on the side.label: Solo - lying on the side
Solo - lying on the side.brief: {A} lies on one side, propped on the lower elbow, the top leg bent over the other, the free hand at the waist, face to the lens.

Solo - lying on the stomach.label: Solo - lying on the stomach
Solo - lying on the stomach.brief: {A} lies face down with the elbows under the shoulders and the chin on the hands, ankles crossed in the air, eyes to the camera.

Solo - walking toward camera.label: Solo - walking toward camera
Solo - walking toward camera.brief: {A} walks toward the camera mid-step, one leg forward, arms swinging naturally, chin up, eyes on the lens.

Solo - leaning on a wall.label: Solo - leaning on a wall
Solo - leaning on a wall.brief: {A} leans one shoulder against a wall, the near leg bent with the foot flat on the wall, arms crossed, face to the camera.

Solo - leaning forward on a table.label: Solo - leaning forward on a table
Solo - leaning forward on a table.brief: {A} leans forward with both forearms on a table, shoulders down, face lifted to the camera, hips back.

Solo - stretching, arms up.label: Solo - stretching, arms up
Solo - stretching, arms up.brief: {A} stands with both arms stretched overhead, fingers linked, back arched, face lifted and eyes closed.

Solo - dancing.label: Solo - dancing
Solo - dancing.brief: {A} is caught mid-dance with the hips swung to one side, one arm high and the other across the body, head turned to the camera.

Solo - back to camera, looking back.label: Solo - back to camera, looking back
Solo - back to camera, looking back.brief: {A} stands with the back to the camera, both arms raised to the hair, head turned so one eye meets the lens over the shoulder.

Solo - sitting on a bed.label: Solo - sitting on a bed
Solo - sitting on a bed.brief: {A} sits on the edge of a bed facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, hands braced either side of the hips, leaning back slightly.

Solo - on all fours, SFW.label: Solo - on all fours, SFW
Solo - on all fours, SFW.brief: {A} is on hands and knees side-on to the camera, back flat, head turned to the lens, hips level.

Solo - jumping.label: Solo - jumping
Solo - jumping.brief: {A} is airborne with both knees tucked and both arms out, hair and clothing lifted, face to the camera.

Solo - sitting on a windowsill.label: Solo - sitting on a windowsill
Solo - sitting on a windowsill.brief: {A} sits sideways on a windowsill with both legs drawn up, one arm around the knees, head against the glass, face to the camera.

Couple - standing side by side.label: Couple - standing side by side
Couple - standing side by side.brief: {A} and {B} stand shoulder to shoulder facing the camera, the near arms around each other's waists, both faces to the lens.

Couple - holding hands, walking.label: Couple - holding hands, walking
Couple - holding hands, walking.brief: {A} and {B} walk toward the camera hand in hand, mid-step, faces to each other and then to the lens, arms linked.

Couple - embracing.label: Couple - embracing
Couple - embracing.brief: {A} and {B} stand chest to chest, arms around each other's backs, heads resting together, eyes closed.

Couple - forehead to forehead.label: Couple - forehead to forehead
Couple - forehead to forehead.brief: {A} and {B} stand close with foreheads touching, eyes closed, hands on each other's arms, faces in profile to the camera.

Couple - lifting.label: Couple - lifting
Couple - lifting.brief: {B} holds {A} up with both arms under the thighs, {A}'s arms around {B}'s neck and legs around the waist, both faces to the camera.

Couple - dipping.label: Couple - dipping
Couple - dipping.brief: {B} dips {A} backward with one arm behind the shoulders, {A} holds {B}'s shoulder, one leg lifted, both faces to each other.

Couple - dancing.label: Couple - dancing
Couple - dancing.brief: {A} and {B} hold a dance frame, one pair of hands joined and the other on the waist and shoulder, caught mid-turn, faces close.

Couple - piggyback.label: Couple - piggyback
Couple - piggyback.brief: {A} rides on {B}'s back with arms around the neck, {B}'s hands under the thighs, both faces to the camera.

Couple - sitting together.label: Couple - sitting together
Couple - sitting together.brief: {A} and {B} sit side by side on the floor with shoulders touching, legs out, hands resting together in the laps, faces to the lens.

Couple - lying head to head.label: Couple - lying head to head
Couple - lying head to head.brief: {A} and {B} lie on their backs head to head, faces turned to the camera, arms loose at the sides, ankles crossed.

Couple - back hug.label: Couple - back hug
Couple - back hug.brief: {B} stands behind {A} with arms wrapped around the waist, chin on {A}'s shoulder, {A}'s hands over {B}'s, both faces to the camera.

Couple - kiss.label: Couple - kiss
Couple - kiss.brief: {A} and {B} kiss face to face, eyes closed, one hand on the other's jaw, heads tilted slightly, framed from the chest up.

Couple - dancing close.label: Couple - dancing close
Couple - dancing close.brief: {A} and {B} sway together chest to chest, {A}'s arms over {B}'s shoulders and {B}'s hands at {A}'s waist, temples touching.

Couple - lifting on the shoulders.label: Couple - lifting on the shoulders
Couple - lifting on the shoulders.brief: {B} stands upright holding {A} up by the thighs so {A} sits on {B}'s shoulders, {A}'s hands on {B}'s head, both faces up to the camera.

Couple - sitting back to back.label: Couple - sitting back to back
Couple - sitting back to back.brief: {A} and {B} sit back to back on the floor with knees drawn up, heads tilted back against each other, eyes closed.
